title: Herbal Vietnamese Penne Bowl
description: A fragrant, monsoon-inspired bowl that pairs penne rigate with katsuramuki and fresh herbs, finished with a zesty lime‑sesame dressing.
instructions: Boil the penne in salted water for 8 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a wok over medium heat and stir‑fry the tofu until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and a pinch of chili flakes to the wok and cook for 30 seconds.
Insert katsuramuki and zucchini, stir‑fry for 3 minutes until tender.
Return the cooked penne to the wok and toss to combine.
Stir in fish sauce, soy sauce, and a splash of lime juice, letting the flavors meld for 1 minute.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the mixture and stir well.
Transfer the bowl to a Korean brass bowl and sprinkle with cilantro, thai basil, and a touch of sesame oil.
Serve immediately, optionally adding extra lime wedges or chili flakes.
Enjoy the herbal, fresh, and balanced flavor profile.
